'''GS-908''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]]. In [[3637 BBY]] it was escorting the GSI survey team working on mapping the [[Emperor's Eye (temple)|Emperor's Eye]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. When the [[Invasion of Ziost]] happened and [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] wiped all life on the planet, the droid malfunctioned. It later attacked those who returned the surface of the dead world, only to be destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
GS-908 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' during a daily mission on Ziost.<ref name="SWTOR" />
